worldcombat.work.hand_crank.hint: Select a Create hand crank. Your companion approaches and keeps operating it; the crank determines speed and stress. Threats pause work. Stop or another order ends it.
worldcombat.work.hand_crank.stop_hint: End work and follow again; the crank coasts and stops under its native rules.
worldcombat.work.hand_crank.jei: A sent-out controlled companion can operate a hand crank in either direction from its command menu. It approaches and keeps using the native empty-hand interaction; Create determines speed and stress. Work continues until stopped, replaced by another order, or the crank becomes unavailable. Threats pause work, which resumes when they pass.
